author: Polly Heiss
quote: the stitching at the top helm came off after just one week of use.
paraphrase: Siena Pro Tote top handle stitching failed within a week.

author: EWC Chow
quote: Size smaller than expected. Bought it for an overseas trip and ended up not using it.
paraphrase: Smaller than expected; never used on overseas trip.

author: Hiko Saemon
quote: I wish internal pockets and dividers allowed some shallower pockets
paraphrase: Deep internal pockets made items sink to bottom.

author: Denise Dauphin
quote: The bag becomes too heavy when packed and should have wheels
paraphrase: Heavy when full; wished for wheels.

author: Lisa Moore
quote: unfortunately it is made of some other material.
paraphrase: Siena Hobo material and beige shade didn't match other Nordace bags.

author: Shoji Ishikawa
quote: The clasp came off after a month of use.
paraphrase: Clasp failed after a month; raised rating because customer care handled it well.

author: Ali
quote: Finally issue resolved via a discount on a replacement bag
paraphrase: Faulty bag outside warranty resolved with discount on replacement after difficult process.

author: Sarah F
quote: My phone bag lasted one year before the strap broke
paraphrase: Strap broke after a year; Nordace replaced free.

author: Pam Konrad
quote: Although that made it too heavy for me to use as a crossover purse.
paraphrase: Loved color and capacity but too heavy for crossbody.

author: Jamil Khair
quote: Very heavy bag even when empty! Too heavy for me.
paraphrase: Too heavy even empty; never used.

author: StuieB
quote: It's a lot of money for not a lot of bag.

author: Helen Gay
quote: I have now been waiting for over 3 weeks for a refund or another bag in a different colour
paraphrase: Waited weeks for refund/exchange of unopened duplicate.
